summary: The filing is a Form 6-K by Canadian Imperial Bank of Commerce (CIBC) for the month of May 2026, attaching certifications under Rules 13a-14/15d-14 and Section 906 of the Sarbanes-Oxley Act in connection with its quarterly report for the period ended April 30, 2026. No special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or forced management change is discussed. This is a routine regulatory filing with no transaction, corporate action, or event that qualifies as a special situation.
